outcome_detail: Claims against Sheriff Chris Nanos and chief of staff Cameron Johnson were dismissed July 21, 2025, after the plaintiff's attorney agreed to dismiss them in exchange for production of documents including the internal affairs investigation; claims against Ricardo Garcia remained active as of July 2025.
criminal_detail: Ricardo 'Ricky' Garcia was convicted by a jury in December 2024 of attempted sexual assault and sexual abuse (acquitted of sexual assault) and was sentenced on February 24, 2025, to one year in jail, three years of probation, and sex-offender registration. Separately, the Arizona Attorney General found in 2024 that no crimes were committed in the department's handling of the case.
description: A Pima County Sheriff's Department deputy filed a $900,000 notice of claim in June 2023 — a precursor to a lawsuit — against Pima County, Sheriff Chris Nanos, chief of staff Cameron Johnson, and Sgt. Ricardo Garcia, seeking $225,000 from each. According to the claim, Garcia, then her supervisor in the school resources unit, sexually assaulted her at a December 2022 Christmas party at his home, and the department responded inadequately. Garcia was criminally convicted in December 2024 of attempted sexual assault and sexual abuse and was sentenced in February 2025 to one year in jail, three years of probation, and sex-offender registration. In the civil case, claims against Nanos and Johnson were dismissed in July 2025 under an agreement tied to the county producing internal affairs records, while claims against Garcia remained active.
